response.sql:
SELECT tr.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS matched_record_count
FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
  ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
WHERE ab.patsim >= 0.439
GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
ORDER BY tr.ordertypedist NULLS FIRST;

assumptions.assumption: Count each matched advancedbehavior-to-transactionrecord pair; the transaction record key is unique, so each advanced behavior record can match at most one transaction record.
